ns2:course.label: Seminar in Regional Science
ns2:course.description: Discusses advanced topics in regional science; prepares students for dissertation and thesis research, applied study for public agency, or other student research. Same as UP 557. Prerequisite: GEOG 556 or consent of instructor.
